title: Android release uses debug signing
reproduction steps: Run flutter build appbundle --release and inspect signing certificate
recommended fix: Configure a release signing config from secure CI secrets and verify the artifact

title: First launch ignored device locale
evidence: Fixed: explicit-choice marker plus platform preferred-locale resolution; 38 locale/catalog tests pass
reproduction steps: Launch fresh install with French or Arabic device locale
recommended fix: Deploy migration and complete device-level verification

title: Static analysis baseline is non-clean
recommended fix: Remove warnings and deprecations or establish a reviewed warning baseline

title: Tests emit unmocked SharedPreferences MissingPluginException
evidence: flutter test output contains repeated MissingPluginException from plugins.flutter.io/shared_preferences
recommended fix: Initialize/mimic SharedPreferences in test setup and make suite exit status reproducible

title: Broad media permissions declared
reproduction steps: Use the image picker on supported Android versions then inspect needed permissions
recommended fix: Remove manifest permissions if system picker/file selector works without them

title: Account deletion is not failure-atomic
evidence: Storage objects are removed before auth.admin.deleteUser and no durable retry/job exists
reproduction steps: Force auth deletion to fail after a successful Storage removal
recommended fix: Implement a durable server-side deletion workflow with retry/audit state and test it against isolated Supabase
